heading: Codex working plugins
intro: The same onboarding will keep existing plugins and add only the missing tools selected for your work:

states.install-after-confirmation: Missing — install after the same confirmation.
states.activate-after-confirmation: Missing — activation in the Codex plugin interface is required before this capability is ready.
states.offer-activation: Optional — offer activation without blocking the rest of setup.
states.offer-opt-in: Optional specialist tool — install only after an explicit request.
states.withhold-missing-prerequisite: Not selected because its required local application was not detected.
states.recommend-after-validation: Recommendation pending a representative validation run.
states.offer-connection: Optional external connection requiring separate consent.
states.withhold-pending-benchmark: Not selected until its dependencies and behavior are benchmarked.

audit: Inventory: {plugins} installed plugins and {skills} standalone skills. Existing items are retained; unrelated items are not removed.
pending: Plugin installation or activation has not started yet.
